extracted.name: Simple Summer Smoothie
extracted.description: Banana, strawberries, blueberries, and cherries with a touch of honey are my favorite ingredients for this smoothie.
instruction_lines: Place the banana, strawberries, blueberries, cherries, and ice cubes into a blender. Pour in the orange juice, vanilla yogurt, and honey. Puree until smooth.
